## Essay use

Book-length development of the 1991 article's bridge between analytical psychology and nonlinear dynamics. Use it for fuller clinical/symbolic examples, individuation, basin boundaries, and the dynamism of complexes.

**Claim boundary:** distinguish Van Eenwyk's explanatory analogy from the essay's stronger arche-topos derivation and from mathematical claims about specific dynamical systems.
